coverage.summary: Applies to any tenant of residential premises. The text states no unit-count, construction-date, landlord-size or owner-occupancy limits.

result.notes: The section protects any tenant of residential premises and has no building-class limits, so requires_unknown_facts is false. The 'except for nonpayment of rent' carve-out only limits when the six-month presumption arises. It is not a building, unit or owner exemption, so it is left out of unverifiable_exemptions. The other documents (c. 40P, c. 151B, the bills, the SJC opinion and secondary sources) do not bear on the coverage of § 18.
